description: This file provides a database connection management module for a Python project. It handles creating, initializing, and closing a connection pool, and offers utility functions for executing queries, fetching data, and managing database connections in a safe context.

methods.name: Optional[ConnectionPool] _create_pool()
methods.description: Creates a new psycopg connection pool if the DATABASE_URL is configured, with default settings suitable for small deployments and tests.

methods.name: Optional[ConnectionPool] get_pool()
methods.description: Returns the global connection pool if it has been initialized, else None.

methods.name: None init_pool()
methods.description: Initializes the global connection pool if it has not been initialized yet. Safe to call multiple times.

methods.name: None close_pool()
methods.description: Closes the global connection pool and resets the reference to None.

methods.name: Iterator[psycopg.Connection] get_conn()
methods.description: Context manager yielding a database connection from the pool, with automatic commit, rollback, and cleanup.

methods.name: int execute(sql: str, params: Sequence[Any] | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with optional parameters and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: Optional[tuple] fetchone(sql: str, params: Sequence[Any] | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the first row, or None if no rows are found.

methods.name: list[tuple] fetchall(sql: str, params: Sequence[Any] | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all rows as a list of tuples.

methods.name: Any fetchval( sql: str, params: Sequence[Any] | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, default: Any | None = None, )
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the first column of the first row, or a default value if no rows are returned.
